Set up the $n$th term equation for the arithmetic progression with $d = 3$ and $u_n = 94$:
$$a + (n - 1)3 = 94 \implies a + 3n - 3 = 94 \implies a = 97 - 3n$$

Set up the sum equation $S_n = 1420$ using $S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a + l)$:
$$\frac{n}{2}(a + 94) = 1420 \implies n(a + 94) = 2840$$

Substitute $a = 97 - 3n$ into the sum equation:
$$n(97 - 3n + 94) = 2840 \implies n(191 - 3n) = 2840$$
$$3n^2 - 191n + 2840 = 0$$

Factorise and solve for the integer number of terms $n$:
$$(n - 40)(3n - 71) = 0 \implies n = 40 \quad \left(\text{since } n \in \mathbb{Z}^+\right)$$
$$a = 97 - 3(40) = 97 - 120 = -23$$
$$n = 40, \quad a = -23$$
